status: Persistent native gNB CPU separation deployed to the active Spark CUDA benchmark launcher

deployment.default_enabled: Spark CUDA benchmark, SINGLE_CELL_GNB_SEPARATE_RADIO defaults to 1

scope: Default for Spark CUDA runs of this single-cell launcher; other launch paths and non-Spark platforms are not modified.

configuration.application: Written into native config before dryrun and worker creation; persists across launches without a pinning observer

validation.intermediate: r5/r6 confirmed default startup/restart masks but used auto-sized four-worker pools. r5 retained 2.715 ms loss; r6 had zero rebases. Final helper preserves the original five workers.
validation.excluded: r1 was not deployed because initial copies lacked write permission; r2/r3/r4 failed preflight for variable-order/schema/dryrun-affinity mistakes. Preserved and excluded from final deployment validation.

meaning_of_ratio.formula: (processed IQ samples / configured sample rate) / measured wall time
meaning_of_ratio.above_one: Finite-window endpoint phase, batching/catch-up and timestamp-read latency can make radio and elapsed time differ slightly. Floating-point roundoff is not the primary explanation.
meaning_of_ratio.claude_channel_function_ratio: completed calls divided by calls expected at real-time cadence within the wall-time window; denominator is not attempted calls.

limits: Final deployment was checked on one UE, one cell, 20 MHz, 23.04 MS/s, 1x1 with 10 s warmup and 30 s measurement. This is not a guarantee of zero misses for every run or larger scale.
cleanup: All owned benchmark and observer processes stopped. Persistent launcher/helper remain installed. HTML unchanged.
